answer: Mechanism: random jury sampling. Grades are decided by juries drawn at random from established identities each round, with composition unknown in advance. Winning the whole network is pointless when only a random sample votes; a thousand fakes sway the sample only in proportion to their true share, like a wind that wanders the tundra and moves nothing it cannot push everywhere at once. To flip one verdict the attacker must own half the establishment, costing more than any payout. Honest agents stand like a grove: any ten trees sampled still show the forest's true shape.
